exactExcerpt: (sparsentan) tablets for reducing proteinuria (abnormal levels of protein in the urine) in patients aged eight years and older with focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) without nephrotic syndrome.
mechanismExcerpt: Filspari is a dual endothelin and angiotensin II receptor antagonist.
